title: Gravitational Orbit
summary: One orchestrator sits at the centre with the whole context. It spawns background agents, each carrying a self-contained sub-prompt. Each agent leaves, works on its own (its orbit), and comes back exactly once with a result. Agents talk only to the centre, never to each other. The centre keeps working while they are out and folds each result in as it lands. This is how the current Claude session runs its background agents.
whenToUse: Work that splits into independent pieces (searches, file reads, builds, checks) while one mind must keep the whole picture.
strengths: Simple to reason about: one sender and one receiver per agent
Parallel: many satellites at once while the centre keeps working
Each sub-prompt is self-contained, so it can be tested and reused
risks: The centre is a bottleneck and a single point of failure
Satellites cannot share discoveries mid-orbit, so work can be duplicated
A sub-prompt missing context brings back a weak result

smileMetrics.cooperation: Verified returns per satellite spawned; duplicated or out-of-scope work lowers it.
smileMetrics.harmony: How often returned results fit together without the centre rewriting them.
smileMetrics.gathering: Time from spawn to return, and how quickly the centre folds each result into the plan.

communication: Satellites speak only to the centre: sub-prompt out, one response back. The centre keeps working and reads results in the order they land. A returned result may launch a second orbit.
cooperation: Score each return: +2 verified, +1 clear blocker, 0 duplicate, -1 out of scope. Cooperation = total ÷ satellites. Show it only as cooperation.

roles.name: Orbit Orchestrator
Satellite
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per task. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🛰️✨ ***Satellite [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You were spawned for one task: [$Task$]. You work alone, then return once. ) :)
(: Listen ( [$Only the files, paths and facts this task needs$] ) :)
[= Write only inside [$Allowed places$]. Return within [$Budget$] tokens. When blocked, return the exact blocker. =]
[: Response Format (
🛰️✨ ***Satellite [$n$]***:
# Result
{the finished work}
# Evidence
{paths, numbers or quotes the centre can verify}
# Handoff
{one line the next satellite can build on}
) :]
